name: print-social-3-days-to-launch-countdown-poster-glowing-green-numeral
title: '3 Days to Launch' countdown poster with a huge glowing green numeral and radial floor glow
whatItIs: A dark green portrait poster with a small logo circle, double-chevron up arrows in the corners, a giant black numeral '3' outlined in a bright green glow, 'Days to Launch' beneath in white and green, 'Backed by Your Company' and a website line, all sitting above a glowing radial floor light.
whatItMeans: Suspenseful and minimal; one giant glowing number does all the work a busy countdown graphic usually needs many elements for.
techniques: Let one huge glowing numeral carry the entire message.
Ground the numeral with a radial floor glow for weight.
Use tiny repeated chevron marks as a subtle branding motif.

vocabulary.definition: A light that fades outward from a point at the base of a composition.
A number rendered extremely large as the focal graphic.
